incidents.cause: The deer that ran onto the runway contacting the airplane.  A factor associated with the accident was the dark night conditions.
The student pilot's improper flare which resulted in a hard landing.
The pilot’s failure to maintain clearance from terrain during a toe-in landing to sloping terrain which resulted in a loss of helicopter control.
The pilot’s failure to maintain clearance from an elk while maneuvering at a low altitude.

The right-seated pilot’s failure to correct the left-seated pilot’s mismanagement of the engine thrust, which resulted in undesired speed and thrust oscillations during the final approach and a subsequent descent into terrain.
The pilot’s intentional inflight operation of the propeller in beta, which led to an aerodynamic lock, his inability to restore forward thrust, and subsequent collision with terrain.
